data.one_liner: Dart common utility library containing date, regex, timer, currency, and object helpers.
data.what_it_does: Provides a suite of utility classes for common Dart operations including DateUtil, EncryptUtil, JsonUtil, LogUtil, MoneyUtil, NumUtil, ObjectUtil, RegexUtil, TextUtil, TimelineUtil, and TimerUtil.
use_when: You need standard utility functions for dates, strings, regex, and math without writing them manually
You want to perform precise decimal arithmetic to prevent precision loss
avoid_when: You only need a single lightweight helper function and want to avoid importing a large utility package
You need Flutter-specific utilities like SharedPreferences or screen adaptation (which are in the separate flustars package)
strengths: Comprehensive collection of common helper tools in one place
Includes precise number and money calculations to avoid precision issues
weaknesses: Changelog entries lack detailed descriptions, listing only generic TODOs
Monolithic utility library rather than modular packages
